# Case 1: r = 0, basic 3-element row
{"row":[0,1,4],"r":0}
@ skip self at index 0; keep 1 and 2 in order
{"idx":[1,2],"dist":[1,4]}

# Case 2: r = 1, middle element
{"row":[2,0,3],"r":1}
@ skip self at index 1; keep 0 and 2 in order
{"idx":[0,2],"dist":[2,3]}

# Case 3: r = 2, last element
{"row":[5,1,0],"r":2}
@ skip self at index 2; keep 0 and 1
{"idx":[0,1],"dist":[5,1]}

# Case 4: single element row
{"row":[0],"r":0}
@ only self → neighbors slice should be empty
{"idx":[],"dist":[]}

# Case 5: longer row, nontrivial values
{"row":[10,0.5,3.3,7.7,2.2],"r":3}
@ r = 3 → skip index 3, keep 0,1,2,4
{"idx":[0,1,2,4],"dist":[10,0.5,3.3,2.2]}
